# Intentional exceptions for .github/scripts/check_dependabot_coverage.py.
# Format: <package-ecosystem|compose-naming> <path-or-glob>   # reason
#   <package-ecosystem> takes a Dependabot-style directory, e.g.:  pip /tools/experimental
#   compose-naming takes a compose file path, e.g.:                compose-naming /tools/foo/services.yml
# Globs `*` (one path segment) and `**` (any depth) are supported.
# Always state why the path must not be tracked by Dependabot.
